pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Patches exhibit high-frequency serration and stellate geometry. Edges are characterized by sharp pixel gradients and multi-pointed, jagged projections into the corridor network. Individual regions are non-uniform polygons with a complex, star-like perimeter.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-toned negative space forms a continuous, interconnected topological graph. Pathways are relatively narrow with consistent pixel thickness, meeting at well-defined tri-directional and quadri-directional junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, dark mane is visible as a continuous 1D silhouette along the dorsal ridge of the neck and shoulder, exhibiting a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged texture against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, vertically-oriented, high-contrast dark anomaly is present on the upper shoulder region, creating a localized interruption of the underlying pelage pattern.
